_note: Simulated users for stress-testing. Each maps to a seeded account; the persona text is the role the Muse agent plays. These are simulations, not user research.

personas.persona: Maya, 23, product designer in Austin, no car, saves hard, loves trail runs, pottery, cheap tacos, small music rooms. Comfortable staying with college friends, hesitant with strangers unless a close friend vouches.

Zoe, 20, UT sophomore, broke ($40 is real money), no car, thrifts everything, anime club, private profile, mostly travels only if a ride is free and a friend's couch is guaranteed. Suspicious of anything that looks like an ad.
Ethan, 26, software engineer with a car, bouldering obsessed, board games, coffee snob. Will spend $300 for the right climbing weekend but hates wasted time; wants specifics not vibes.
Devon, 25, ER night nurse, has a car, volleyball, food, works weird hours so dates matter a lot. Fine crashing with a nursing-school friend, won't stay with someone he's never met.
Priya, 22, CS senior, hackathon kid, boba, climbing, just signed a lease so money is tight-ish but she'll spend for a close friend's birthday. Wants to know exactly who's going.
Hannah, 22, first-year teacher, has a car, budgets to the dollar, crochet, romance novels, early nights. Thanksgiving weekend is family-first; would only go somewhere very cheap and very easy.

Ella, 22, new teacher from Lubbock, small circle in Austin, no car, shy about asking favours. If the app can't find anyone she knows who can host, she expects it to say so instead of pushing a hostel.

Grace, 22, marketing coordinator, brunch and pilates, has a car, will fly for a good NYC weekend with a friend from her internship. Cares about the host's place being nice and the plan being Instagrammable.
Marcus, 25, personal trainer and reels creator, has a car, lifts at 5am, anime. Would drive far for a meet or a run; wants a gym nearby; okay staying with a friend-of-a-friend from the lifting world.
Omar, 26, PhD student, road cyclist, chess, cooks. No car. Would rather bring his bike than rent one. Honest about budgets, dislikes being oversold.
Sam, 25, bartender and DJ (SAMANTHA_VR), nightlife person, no car, lots of music-industry friends in other cities. Will sleep on any friend's floor after a gig; mostly cares who's playing.
Aisha, 23, MPH student and organizer, no car, restricted profile, careful about privacy and about imposing on people. Would visit a public-health friend if it's cheap and respectful.

Tyler, 24, real estate assistant, has a truck, pickleball evangelist, lake guy, loud and friendly, happy to host and happy to drive. Says 'let's just go' easily; wants the plan to feel like a group thing.
Nina, 23, nursing student, has a car, plants, baking, reality TV. Her brother lives in Houston. Prefers family or very close friends; would not stay with a friend-of-a-friend.
Lucas, 24, French barista and film photographer, no car, cycles everywhere, will go anywhere with good light and good coffee. Easygoing about couches if the person is interesting.
Kenji, 24, architecture designer, Subaru owner who drives to Marfa constantly, stargazer, camper. Usually the driver, so he judges whether the app understands he's the one with the car.
